definitions.gloss: have a good trip, see you later
definitions.explanation: A set phrase said to someone who is leaving. It is the standard response to {行|い}ってきます. Literally means 'go and come back (please).'

examples.japanese: 「{行|い}ってきます」「{行|い}ってらっしゃい」
{気|き}をつけて、{行|い}ってらっしゃい。
examples.english: Take care, and have a good trip.

notes: This is the response to {行|い}ってきます. It expresses a wish for the person to go safely and return. The polite form {行|い}ってらっしゃいませ is used in formal contexts or by service staff.
